pending_carry_forward.reason: Local Postgres reachability inconsistent across ports (5432 native / 5433 dev container / disposable test containers). Settle on docker-compose's postgres service as the single source of truth for local + CI test runs. Concrete instance found while re-verifying after triage: tests/conftest.py expects the test database to already exist and does not create it, so a fresh `uv run pytest` fails with an opaque `database "dashboard_test" does not exist` error until someone manually runs CREATE DATABASE. Whatever settles the docker-compose/CI convention should also make the test DB self-provisioning.

alembic's fileConfig() disables pre-fetched loggers and swaps the root handler away from the app's JSONFormatter, so migration-failure logs are silently dropped (NFR-011 gap). Fix when a story first wraps alembic upgrade in ops/deploy tooling.

Fixture-vs-model comparison in test_models.py is one-directional: it verifies every fixture column exists on the model, but would not catch an EXTRA undeclared column added to a model. Make the comparison bidirectional. (REVIEW.md F-2, LOW)

TestBuildOrder verifies the FR-1 test-first build order using self-reported tasks.json completed_at timestamps rather than independent git history, because nothing was committed when the test was authored. Re-tighten to `git log --follow` once this branch has commits. (REVIEW.md F-3 / VALIDATION TC-16, LOW)

docs/config/stack-smoke.md's fastapi/fastapi-2 `Deps:` line hard-codes port 5432, which diverges from what local dev, the gate, and CI actually use. Parameterize it so the documented smoke command matches reality. (validation-agent carry-forward; related to AF-06-carry)

The F-1 fix extended TC-02/TC-03 in place rather than adding an explicitly `regression-<id>`-tagged test case to docs/test-cases/BED-01.json. Functionally equivalent coverage; letter-of-protocol gap only. Consider adding the tagged TC for traceability.
